title: delegation_refresh_cut normalize() masks timestamps by sorted substring replacement, so restartRecovery.restartedAt leaks its fraction and two tests fail whenever the hour is 00-19 UTC (blocks every FULL until 20:00Z)
outcome: The delegation refresh equivalence tests pass at every time of day. normalize() masks each timestamp value whole, so a short HH:MM:SS value can never be replaced inside a longer RFC3339 value, and a regression test pins the failing ordering.
acceptance: normalize() in src/tests/delegation_refresh_cut.rs replaces whole timestamp values (or applies substitutions longest-first) so an HH:MM:SS value equal to the time part of an RFC3339 value cannot corrupt that RFC3339 value.

A regression test builds an RFC3339 restartedAt sharing its HH:MM:SS with a message timestamp at an hour before 20 and shows both are masked; the two named tests pass independent of the wall-clock hour.
No product code changes; the change is test-only and passes `cargo fmt --check`.
